| Requirement      | Observed behavior | Check and result     | Evidence                | Status            |
| ---------------- | ----------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------- |
| [normal outcome] | [what happened]   | [exact command/flow] | [log/screenshot/result] | Pass/Fail/Skipped |

Record empty/failure behavior and meaningful constraints. List skipped checks with prerequisites and an owner. Separate implementation complete, local verified, exported verified and live verified. Acceptance requires human review of scope and behavior against current main; a passing earlier commit or fixture-only provider test is insufficient for a live claim.
